explanation: Requested a 5-step linear scan of cos(theta*) from -1 to +1 at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg for eta electroproduction. The naive scan endpoints (-1.0 and +1.0) sit exactly on the known integration poles documented for this code (cos(theta*) = +/-1.0 causes the EXCLURAD integrator to fail), so the two endpoint values were clamped to -0.999 and +0.999 as recommended; the interior points (-0.5, 0, 0.5) were left unchanged. All 5 points lie well above the eta+p threshold (W_threshold = 1.4861 GeV) and within the EtaMAID-2023 lookup table coverage (W in [1.4856, 6.0], Q2 in [0, 5.0]), and preflight_check returned PASS for all 5 points with no warnings. A single input file (5 points, under the 10-point-per-file Fortran reader limit) was generated in byte-compatible EXCLURAD format.
